domains.knowledge: Source/guide maps, proposed ADR status, delivery evidence, incident lifecycle and publication boundary reconciled; generated views do not accept decisions or renew reviews.

findings: Removed Standard-only assumptions from quota selection, persistence and admission-denial recovery while retaining central authority and selected-pool isolation.
Corrected actual output-limit forwarding and terminal stream completion; no fixture-only expectation change substitutes for runtime behavior.
Unified run/stream checkpoint logic; retained callback results, original usage/attempt budget, display-only partial output and explicit bounded compaction.
Added expected-revision persistence fencing; failed initial/final and parallel callback saves retain local evidence and prevent automatic continuation.
Kept private diagnostics out of public JSON/SSE, distinguished failed streams from successful persistence, and maintained no-replay classification across SDK/browser helpers.
Reconciled current local delivery with unchanged closed gates; prior registration, database and image evidence remain separately dated.
Retained ADR0155 as proposed and ACT025 open; no auto-acceptance, provider readiness or published SDK claim.

limits: No real provider request, measured provider balance, induced real exhaustion or production blast-radius claim.
Runtime images are installed locally; public chat application and SDK publication are not performed.
Both execution gates remain closed. Premium retains one paused connected account; Standard has none.
Crash-safe cross-process continuation requires caller-owned authenticated persistence with atomic expected-revision checks.
No exactly-once external callback guarantee, automatic unknown-request replay or cross-pool failover.
Conservative per-turn reservations do not replace aggregate customer concurrency/spend policy.
No database schema or data changes in the quota task; prior registration cleanup remains separately evidenced.
Compiled scans cover this local build, not the live public site. No new graphical chat UX or browser acceptance claimed.
Broader fingerprint inventories detect drift but do not certify every unchanged module or guide.
Database changes belong to the prior connection task and its retained review; no new database review stamped.
